entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh yeah, I checked the Phan-Site while[n]you were sleeping.
With those paws?
See anything interesting?
You're paying for my data!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, I can't type that well, but I can[n]at least scroll up and down.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That aside, there was a post that caught[n]my eye.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, I found something.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I knew you were gonna say that!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look, would you quit joking for a second[n]and listen!? There was a forum post[n]that caught my eye.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A lot of cats have been going missing in[n]Yongen. The owners are apparently[n]worried they've been kidnapped.
Who did it?
Do we have a name?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The main suspect seems to be this office[n]worker named "Neko Nora." People have[n]heard meowing coming from her place.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She's got a history with catnapping, too.[n]Apparently the police even had to get[n]involved.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But it's not that simple. I was worried[n]about the cats, so I went to take a peek[n]into the target's room.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But the cats were all eating classy gourmet[n]cat food! And she was just watching with[n]this gentle, happy look on her face...
What's going on?
Weird...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We need to find out what her motive is.[n]From what I saw, I honestly don't think[n]she's a bad person at heart.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How about we get more information on[n]her, and then go to Mementos?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'd rather not use force to change her[n]heart if we can avoid it. Maybe we can[n]just persuade her.
When investigating requests, you may[n]find that you can change a target's heart[n]nonviolently by speaking up mid-battle.
For this to succeed, you will need to[n]gather information in the real world.
Speak to the townspeople and collect[n]information that will aid in changing[n]the target's heart.
